acceptance_contract.interpretation: Each C1.N row corresponds to plan clause N; checks name the evidence subchecks supporting that clause. Shared corpus and provenance checks may be cited by more than one clause.
acceptance_contract.section: C1 — Produce complete multiplayer asset profiles

checks: exact 27-profile matrix and deterministic independent manifests/packages
pinned producer/source-map/source-root provenance
selected scenario and custom roots resolve without campaign scenario roots
requirements.title: Deterministic manifests for UI, stock multiplayer, and survival; source roots, dependencies, hashes, import decisions, package hashes, memory needs, and no campaign scenario roots

checks: retained 336-variant/75-recipe roster and complete 255 combat/mounted occurrence set
exact source-roster recipe comparison including required fields
output-datum-bound actor occurrence references
limitations: Placement recipes do not prove bot runtime behavior
requirements.title: Every resolved retail combat actor variant is imported from retained sources with complete dependencies and valid placement recipes; noncombat/script-only dispositions are explicit and hollow recipes are rejected

checks: fresh schema-derived CE walk and package validation
typed reference and tag-index remaps match schema slots
unique source-occurrence remaps bind every dependency to output identities
duplicate output identities are rejected; dependency source choices remain deterministic through exact rebuild equality
limitations: Host package validation does not prove target loading
requirements.title: Schema-driven import, reference remapping, stable output identities, dependency deduplication, and deterministic source choice for conflicts; no synthesized stock-MP actor references

checks: per-profile bitmap image accounting
native UI bitmap fixture binds final package/source image and reaches native GS packet output
media chunks are integrity checked and resource admission is explicit
live media lifecycle: payload to registered CE request to profile binding to cache lease/upload to actual chain emission

deferred_to.reason: native fixture proves the CE interface request to renderer chain path; registration and queue-end are not bound to the running CE frame because the HCU image has no parent render loop (CE render_frame only publishes a pointer-free snapshot), and renderer chain binding, HUD, and GS-fenced cache reuse are C3 work

details.limitation: host ILP32 queue-end dispatch and command construction; no EE, GS execution, framebuffer, or hardware fence was observed

limitations: Host CE-to-GS packets do not prove framebuffer parity
Native bitmap dispatch is host-only and pre-fence; running-frame binding is deferred to C3
Kept HUD and parent-reader media are live-consumer data under the consumer rule; their hookup into the running HCU frame is deferred to C3.6
requirements.title: CE data is resident for pointer lifetime; render/media payloads use independently addressable integrity-checked chunks, and only proven live-consumer data is included

checks: all selected BSP owners match retail source extents
separate sword/gravity POSE payload provenance and bindings
three custom weapon closures and fuel-rod metadata dispositions are validated
limitations: CBSP and POSE package integrity does not prove C2 placement or rendered frames
requirements.title: Sword, gravity-rifle, and fuel-rod closures and separately sourced presentation assets are provenance-bound, including resolved fuel-rod bitmap metadata

checks: missing/incompatible package dependencies fail fresh validation
sound metadata-only policy and request identities are explicit
CE corrections, memory needs, and native admission limits are evidence-bound
real current UI HCP accepted before same-map teardown; incompatible/corrupt packages rejected while active CE snapshot is preserved
